stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: Can a failed test say what's wrong?
stations.note: Tired of writing the same if.

stations.title: Your runner
stations.text: Knows a test failed, not why.

stations.title: Workshop screen
stations.text: Shows the price wanted and the one quoted.

captions: The runner works. Now Sefton wants every failed test to say what went wrong.
Today the 250 card test fails with a bare Error, and nobody knows why.
You write expectations that compare and explain, in three tasks.
Now the failure shows the price Sefton wanted and the price that came.
Shorter tests, and failures a person can act on at a glance.
